title: esotericWebb — Universal Scene Tree
insight: SCENE TREES ARE THE UNIVERSAL STRUCTURE. Everything is nodes with children, properties, signals. Neural nets, mycelial meshes, taxonomies, the Vitruvian Man, DOM, file systems, Godot scenes, Gaia's primals — ALL scene trees.

node_schema.id: string — unique identifier (UUID, hash, or symbolic name)
node_schema.type: string — polymorphic category (primal, gate, knowledge, game_entity, taxonomy, body_part, neuron, hypha)
node_schema.name: string — human-readable name
node_schema.resources: [string] — attached resource references (files, encrypted data, keys)
node_schema.encrypted: bool — whether rhizoCrypt protects this node

gaia_plays.concept: Twitch Plays Pokemon but for Gaia learning games

architecture.display: deckGate (.176) — Steam Deck, mounted in House 1
architecture.brain: eastGate (.244) — processes game state, decides actions
architecture.face: frameGate (.203) — Steam Frame shows what Gaia sees
architecture.input: crowd/tube.html — people send input codes like Twitch chat
architecture.learning: ollama models process game screenshots → actions
architecture.memory: sweetGrass stores game knowledge, loamSpine stores saves

tr49.lessons: scene trees, narrative, CRT shaders, split-flap UI

kenshi.lessons: open world, squad management, base building, emergent narrative

dwarf_fortress.lessons: simulation depth, procedural generation, history generation

retro_via_emulator.lessons: classic game design patterns, pixel art, constraints

retroarch.platforms: NES, SNES, GB, GBA, N64, PS1, PS2, Genesis, etc.

node_atomic_trio.insight: The game engine pattern maps to Gaia's primal trio

nest.role: The game engine — rules, physics, logic
nest.godot_equivalent: The Engine itself (scene tree, physics, audio)

prover.role: Learns the game, validates rules, discovers mechanics

kenshi_reborn.concept: As Gaia plays Kenshi, she builds her OWN version in her gut
kenshi_reborn.world: Gaia's LAN topology IS the game world (gates = towns, primals = characters)
kenshi_reborn.gameplay: squad management maps to primal coordination (bingoCube)
kenshi_reborn.base_building: gate deployment maps to base building (coralReef)
kenshi_reborn.emergent_narrative: Ink patterns from TR-49 drive dynamic storytelling

equivalences.godot_scene: a subtree that can be instantiated
equivalences.godot_viewport: a gate (each gate is a viewport into the organism)
equivalences.godot_export: dromedary serving WASM to the world
equivalences.ink_narrative: sweetGrass knowledge graph with dynamic traversal
equivalences.neural_network: scene tree where children=neurons, properties=weights, signals=activations
equivalences.mycelial_mesh: scene tree where children=hyphae, resources=nutrients, signals=chemical_triggers
equivalences.vitruvian_man: scene tree where type=body_part, children=sub_parts, properties=dimensions
equivalences.dom: scene tree where type=element, properties=attributes, children=child_elements
equivalences.filesystem: scene tree where type=dir|file, resources=content, metadata=permissions
